description: The dialog to make a chat on a host a Bot (a name, a picture and a memory it reads each time it starts), or change an existing Bot's name and picture. Making a Bot is where its name is set: from then on the Bot is shown by that name alone, everywhere both apps list or show it (sidebar and home rows, the chat's header, notifications, This phone, share targets, the @ and ⌘K lists), never with its chat's title.
opens: phone: session row long-press → Make Bot… / Bot Settings…

parts.name: heading
parts.shows: "Make Bot", or "Bot Settings" for an existing Bot.

parts.name: body
parts.shows: Only when making: "A Bot is a chat with a name, a picture and a memory it reads each time it starts."

parts.name: picture
parts.shows: A round avatar 64px across, centred: the Bot's picture, else its initials from the name typed, set into the page with no outer square or rounded-square border around the circle: see README's A picture is set into the page. Under it two buttons: "Choose Picture…" and (only while there is a picture) "Remove Picture".

actions.does: A file chooser (Pictures) opens; the picture is scaled to fit 256 by 256 and shown. An unreadable one says "Couldn't read that picture: <why>".

decisions.said: Bot icons in Bot Settings had an odd rounded-square border around the circular avatar (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: In every app, the round Bot avatar in Bot Settings sits directly on the dialog with only its circular inset shade (`picture-shade`) and no outer square or rounded-square border.

parts.name: name field
parts.shows: A text entry with placeholder "Name": the Bot's name. Pre-filled with the Bot's name, or for a new one the chat's title (80 characters at most) to keep or type over; focused. The avatar's initials follow it.

parts.name: Save / Make Bot
parts.shows: The default, suggested-style button: "Make Bot" when making, "Save" for settings; disabled while the name is blank.

actions.does: Sends the name (and picture if changed) to the chat's host, which lists the chat as a Bot. A failure says "Couldn't update the Bot: <why>".
